Subject: Your aircraft lease repossession matter (Project Ibis)

Dear Ms. Pai,

Thank you for meeting us on 4 July 2020 about your dispute with M/s Meridian Airways Ltd. As we understand it, the airline has stopped paying lease rentals.

Our advice is to seek deregistration of the aircraft under the international lease convention. Please collect the lease agreement and the irrevocable deregistration authorisation and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
